reference_set.document_title: 2025-2026 WARN Report from July 01, 2025 through June 30, 2026
reference_set.independence_rule: The rows below were transcribed from the official report before any tracker query or match review. This file is not a tracker import.
reference_set.selection_rule: Fixed source-document-position sample: use the first three fully contained June-notice rows and the last three fully contained June-notice rows on each of the report's two June table pages (PDF text page markers P19 and P20). Do not alter the selection after tracker lookup.
reference_set.scope_limit: This sample measures recall only against the public California WARN report. It is not a measure of all US layoffs, all California layoffs, WARN compliance, execution, or job cuts outside the report's statutory scope.

source_permission_note: The report is publicly linked by California EDD and used here only as a manually transcribed, source-linked factual reference sample. California's public-site policy recognizes public access to appropriate government records, but does not supply an explicit automated/commercial bulk-reuse licence. Do not automate collection from this report or republish the document; retain selected factual fields, the official URL and page citations only.

The three added rows have had no tracker lookup of any kind, preserving the pre-lookup independence gate for them. A June-notice row scan of every PDF page confirmed June rows appear only on P19/P20 (physical pages 20-21).
